decisions.reason: The custom earmold sits close to the firm's established hearing-care business and costs little to keep offered, so its option value is preserved while the thin website evidence leaves its prospects unresolved.

The individual EARsleeve has its own page and a clear launch statement, and it extends existing digital earmold production at low marginal cost, so it is worth keeping open as demand for universal in-ear systems develops.

The thermoforming unit fits the firm's core dental equipment line and has its own page, and dropping it would forfeit certification and development investments before the early results have shown anything negative.
